D-04.rationale: CC-BY-4.0, MIT, PDDL and GPLv3 declarations or stable governing texts can be resolved for inspected components. The labels module and complete bundled-asset coverage remain ambiguous, so the all-module condition is not met.

evidence.description: The pinned root includes code, figures, numerical-result definitions, manuscript, Dockerfile, OCI image manifests and Git submodule references.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → Git tree at assessed revision

evidence.description: Declares raw eye-gaze, eye-movement-label and REMoDNaV module URLs; the root Git tree fixes their respective commits.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → .gitmodules and pinned Git tree

evidence.description: The saved OCI-compatible image has content-addressed configuration and layers recorded alongside its image tag. Git annex pointers fix the payload content identities.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → container/image/ → manifest.json and layer pointers

D-05.rationale: The distributed root commit fixes the data/code submodule commits, included files and image content identities together. This establishes a coherent frozen version selection. D-01 separately remains unresolved for successful retrieval of every payload.
D-05.feedback: Pilot application clarified that a frozen joint version selection and successful payload retrieval are separate findings. D-05 now isolates the former; D-01 records the latter.

evidence.description: The README identifies results-containerized as signed; the local tag object contains a PGP signature and points to the recorded analysis commit. No documented signing-key identity verification route was found, and this review did not verify the signature.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → README signed results-containerized reference → tag object

evidence.description: A recorded DataLad execution builds and saves the environment, naming container/Dockerfile as input and container/image as output. It does not record fixed external apt/base-image build resolutions.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → container/image history → recorded image-build commit

evidence.description: The saved OCI-compatible image has content-addressed configuration and layers recorded alongside its image tag. Git annex pointers fix the payload content identities.
evidence.discovery_path: Entry repository → container/image/ → manifest.json and layer pointers

D-06.rationale: Image build provenance and content identities are supplied, and the results tag has a signature. No supplied attestation/signature route linking the distributed executable image to a verified producer identity and build source was established. A checksum alone does not satisfy this binary anchor.
D-06.feedback: Clarify whether a signed Git tag covering an annex image and earlier build commit is sufficient when the object provides no signing-key verification guidance.

assessments.comment: Pilot source-based review for subsequent human review. Inspected pinned repository files, linked modules and selected provenance records; no numerical pipeline, image build or payload retrieval was executed. The README’s reported cross-platform success is not an independently verified result. E-03 and D-01 are intentionally unanswered. Evidence-support and confidence fields do not affect scores. All dimensions have equal weight. Rubric feedback identifies ambiguities discovered during application; no conclusion of general scientific quality or certification is intended.
